description: This source file defines the Order model class for the admin sale module in an OpenCart e-commerce platform. It provides methods for managing orders, including retrieval, deletion, and updating order details in the database.

classes.name: Order
classes.description: The Order class provides methods for managing order records within the admin sale module. It includes functionalities such as retrieving, deleting, updating, and summarizing orders in the database, along with handling related entities like products, options, totals, histories, and subscriptions.

methods.name: deleteOrder
methods.description: Deletes an order record from the database, including associated products, totals, and histories.

methods.name: getOrder
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific order, including customer, product, and status data.

methods.name: getOrders
methods.description: Fetches a list of orders based on filter criteria such as status, date, customer, etc.

methods.name: getTotalOrders
methods.description: Returns the total count of orders matching given filter criteria.

methods.name: getOrdersBySubscriptionId
methods.description: Retrieves orders associated with a specific subscription ID.

methods.name: getTotalOrdersByLanguageId
methods.description: Counts orders associated with a specific language.

methods.name: getTotalOrdersByCurrencyId
methods.description: Counts orders associated with a specific currency.

methods.name: getTotalOrdersBySubscriptionId
methods.description: Counts orders associated with a specific subscription.

methods.name: getTotalOrdersByStoreId
methods.description: Counts orders for a specific store.

methods.name: getTotalOrdersByOrderStatusId
methods.description: Counts orders with a particular order status ID.

methods.name: getTotalOrdersByProcessingStatus
methods.description: Counts orders currently in processing status.

methods.name: getTotalOrdersByCompleteStatus
methods.description: Counts orders with complete status.

methods.name: deleteProducts
methods.description: Removes products associated with a specific order, including related options and subscriptions.

methods.name: getProduct
methods.description: Fetches details of a specific product in an order.

methods.name: getProducts
methods.description: Retrieves all products in a specific order.

methods.name: getTotalProductsByProductId
methods.description: Counts total quantities of a specific product across all orders with status > 0.

methods.name: deleteOptions
methods.description: Deletes all options related to an order.

methods.name: getOptions
methods.description: Retrieves all options associated with a specific order product.

methods.name: deleteSubscription
methods.description: Deletes subscription record for an order.

methods.name: getSubscription
methods.description: Gets subscription details for a specific order product.

methods.name: deleteTotals
methods.description: Deletes the totals related to a specific order.

methods.name: getTotals
methods.description: Retrieves all totals associated with an order.

methods.name: getTotalsByCode
methods.description: Fetches total information for an order filtered by code.

methods.name: getTotalSales
methods.description: Calculates total sales amount based on filter criteria.

methods.name: createInvoiceNo
methods.description: Generates and assigns a new invoice number for an order.

methods.name: getRewardTotal
methods.description: Gets total reward points earned from an order.

methods.name: deleteHistories
methods.description: Removes all history records for an order.

methods.name: getHistories
methods.description: Retrieves history records for a specific order.

methods.name: getTotalHistories
methods.description: Counts total history entries for an order.

methods.name: getTotalHistoriesByOrderStatusId
methods.description: Counts history entries filtered by order status ID.

methods.name: getEmailsByProductsOrdered
methods.description: Fetches emails for orders containing specified products, with pagination.

methods.name: getTotalEmailsByProductsOrdered
methods.description: Counts total emails for orders containing specified products.
